newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cheuvreux adds Peugeot to select list.
newsitem.headline: Cheuvreux adds Peugeot to select list.

text.p: Brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu added PSA Peugeot Citroen to its list of 20 selected stocks on Monday, market sources said.
The move followed Cheuvreux's upgrade on Friday on the carmaker's rating to buy from sell and its 1997 and 1998 earnings forecasts.
It expects the Peugeot group to show a profit this year of 12 francs per share, compared with a previous estimate for a seven franc loss.

For 1998, it expects EPS of 34 francs, up from 22 francs. The improved outlook reflects positive currency movements, notably sterling's rise, and strong sales volumes in light commercial vehicles and car exports outside Europe.
Shares in PSA Peugeot Citroen were up 1.73 percent at 707 francs, a new year high, at 0930 GMT on Monday.
